# Tactical labels — can we build them from Alpamayo meta-actions + reasoning + VLM + ego?

**Question (PI, verbatim, 2026-08-16):** *"what about tactical labels, how they are generated by
vlm in combination with ego and alpamayo meta actions and reasoning? we should validate them since
we need them for training"*

**Answer, in one line:** ⛔ **They are not generated today — and of the three legs the PI names,
only ONE is trustworthy.** Alpamayo (meta-action + reasoning) is a real, complete, structured
source at n=4,729. The VLM's tactical leg is **information-free on the longitudinal axis** (a
constant, κ = 0.0000) and its lateral agreement is an **echo of ego**, not vision. The ego leg
answers a *different question* than the label needs (an 11.9 s net, where the tactical decision is
2 s). ⇒ ~~**A tactical label set IS buildable — from Alpamayo, at a 2 s horizon, with abstention —
but NOT by the 2-of-3 majority vote the pipeline currently implements.**~~

> ⛔ **CORRECTED 2026-08-17 (retraction C89 + the second defect found rebuilding the sheet).**
> **"at a 2 s horizon" was the wrong horizon, and every κ in this document that carries it is a
> SEAM value.** 2.0 s is `OP_BAND_S`'s *end* — the seam — not the tactical band; the binding spec
> is `TAC_BAND_S = (2.0, 6.0)` at `stack/tanitad/models/v6.py:136-140`. Read over the band the
> label is **materially weaker**: **LON κ 0.1428** (CI [0.0540, 0.2250], n=201) and
> **LAT κ 0.1777** (CI [0.0658, 0.2953], n=193), paired-separated from the seam on both axes.
> ⇒ The one-line answer becomes: **a tactical label set is NOT demonstrated buildable at the
> horizon the architecture actually uses.** Full restatement in **§3.1**; artifact
> `…/2026-08-16-tactical-review/raw/b1_band_agreement.json`.

⭐ **The PI's phrasing "meta actions AND reasoning" is exactly right and is the load-bearing
insight of this document.** The two fields carry different halves of the v6 vocabulary and neither
half works alone — see §4.

---

## 0. Two premises in my brief were wrong. Both corrected here.

| premise as briefed | what is actually true |
|---|---|
| *"Alpamayo meta-actions are ingested and displayed, never converted. Nothing maps a meta-action to a `g_tac`/`a_tac` token."* | ⛔ **FALSE.** `stack/scripts/ph1_fuse.py:331-347` **already converts them** and emits `g_tac_lat`/`g_tac_lon` on every fused record. The conversion exists, is shipped, and is one of the things this document finds defective. |
| *"4,472 (94.6 %) have no w120 cache"* read as a label-availability bound | ⛔ **Corrected mid-task by the PI.** Alpamayo's labels are complete for all 4,729 (full camera rig at inference). The bound is on **our video**, not the labels. Both n's are stated separately throughout. |

**What my brief got right and I confirm from source:** there is **no tactical loss term**.
`V6LossWeights` (`stack/scripts/train_v6_staged.py:151-217`) ends at `w_s2_goal: float = 0.0`
(strategic). There is no `w_tac_*` of any kind. **MEASURED** (read from source).

### ⛔ And a third defect, in the emission that does exist

`ph1_fuse.py:346-353` writes the field **`g_tac_lat` / `g_tac_lon`** but fills it from
**`TACTICAL_LAT_ACTIONS` / `TACTICAL_LON_ACTIONS`** — the **`a_tac` ACTION** vocabulary, not the
**`g_tac` GOAL** vocabulary (`TACTICAL_GOAL_TOKENS_LAT/LON`, `v6.py:217-223`). The two are
disjoint: `LANE_KEEP` is not in `TACTICAL_GOAL_TOKENS_LAT`, whose members are `ANCHOR_GOAL`,
`CORRIDOR_OFFSET`, `EVADE_IN_CORRIDOR`, `LAT_UNCONSTRAINED`. The field is an **ACTION wearing a
GOAL's name**, and `stack/tests/test_ph1_fuse.py:70-71` **pins the mismatch** by asserting
`vocab["g_tac_lat"]["token"] in TACTICAL_LAT_ACTIONS`. **MEASURED** (read from source).

⇒ Any consumer joining `g_tac_lat` to a goal head would silently get action tokens. This is the
same class as the S2 `"no agents"` defect — *a shape that reads like the thing it is not.*

## 1. THE SOURCES, CHARACTERISED

### 1.1 Alpamayo `meta_action` — a real structured taxonomy, and it is good

**MEASURED**, `records.parquet` (sha256 `ecae276d…`, verified against HF in
`…/2026-08-06-alpamayo-augmentation/a2_records_stats.json`), **n = 4,729 clips, 0 unparsable rows**.
Artifact: `raw/a1_alpamayo_taxonomy.json`.

**Kind:** *structured-enum-in-text* — a small closed vocabulary emitted as free text on three
labelled lines. Not a typed field (nothing enforces it), not open text (the value set is closed).
**It must be parsed, and an unparsed row counted — never coerced.**

**THREE INDEPENDENT AXES** (this is the architecturally important fact):

| Longitudinal (7) | n | % | Lateral (7) | n | % | Lane (7) | n | % |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| Gentle Deceleration | 1594 | 33.71 | Go Straight | 2504 | 52.95 | Lane Keep | 4035 | 85.33 |
| Maintain Speed | 1225 | 25.90 | Steer Right | 1020 | 21.57 | Turn Right | 101 | 2.14 |
| Gentle Acceleration | 1151 | 24.34 | Steer Left | 649 | 13.72 | Turn Left | 85 | 1.80 |
| Stop | 304 | 6.43 | Sharp Steer Right | 135 | 2.86 | Right Lane Change | 82 | 1.73 |
| Strong Deceleration | 267 | 5.65 | Sharp Steer Left | 115 | 2.43 | Slightly Shift Left | 69 | 1.46 |
| Strong Acceleration | 182 | 3.85 | Reverse Right | 1 | 0.02 | Slightly Shift Right | 31 | 0.66 |
| Reverse | 6 | 0.13 | Reverse Left | 1 | 0.02 | Left Lane Change | 22 | 0.47 |

⚠️ **The 304 "unparsed" lateral/lane rows are NOT parse failures.** They are **exactly** the 304
`Stop` rows (verified: the lateral-null set and the `Stop` set are the same 304 clips). **A
stopped vehicle emits ONE axis only.** Any consumer must treat this as *not applicable*, never as
a missing value to impute — that would be the C77 family again.

⭐ **40.62 % of clips (1,921/4,729) declare a non-trivial action on BOTH the longitudinal and
lateral axes simultaneously** — 98 distinct joint cells. This is precisely what our retired 5-way
mixed softmax could not represent, and it is direct label-side evidence for the `a_tac` LAT×LON
factoring v6 already ships.

### 1.2 The "reasoning" — ⭐ IT EXISTS, IT IS RICH, AND THERE ARE **TWO** OF IT

The PI named "reasoning"; my brief flagged this as possibly an assumption. **It is data.**

| | `meta_action.cot` | `auto_labeling.chain_of_causation` |
|---|---|---|
| coverage | **4,729/4,729 = 100.00 %** | **4,729/4,729 = 100.00 %** |
| distinct strings | 1,103 (23.32 % of rows) | 1,685 |
| length (chars) | p05 37 · **median 49** · p95 85 | — |

Verbatim examples (top of the frequency table): *"Keep distance to the lead vehicle because it is
directly ahead in the same lane"* (n=282) · *"Keep speed through the intersection since the traffic
light is green"* (n=114) · *"Nudge left to pass the parked car on the right"* (n=111) · *"Slow down
for the roundabout because of the yield sign ahead"* (n=61).

**The double-counting check, run before quoting either:** `answer` is byte-identical to `cot` on
**4,729/4,729 (100 %)** — it is a *duplicate field, not a second source*, and must never be cited
as corroboration. `cot_auto_labeling` and `box` are empty on 4,729/4,729 within the `meta_action`
task.

**The two reason legs ARE semi-independent** (this matters — it gives us a repeat measurement):
exact string match on only **1,049/4,729 = 22.18 %**, token-Jaccard mean **0.5613** / median
**0.5714**.

⛔ **A declared sub-field that is always null is not a source.** `auto_labeling`'s schema declares
four; only three carry data, and one is nearly empty:

| sub-field | non-null | % |
|---|---|---|
| `chain_of_causation` | 4729 | **100.00** |
| `critical_components_analysis` | 3140 | 66.40 |
| `ego_vehicle_motion_analysis` | 2943 | 62.23 |
| `trajectory_analysis` | **133** | **2.81** ⛔ effectively absent |

### 1.3 The VLM leg — ⛔ **its longitudinal output carries ZERO information**

Vocabulary (`stack/scripts/ph0_v2.py:39-43`): 11 `GOAL_KINDS`, **6 `ACTION_VERBS`**
(`prepare_lane_change, hold_corridor, reduce_to, prepare_exit, prepare_stop, resume_cruise`).

**MEASURED** over the 201-clip aug120 cohort — 270 action emissions, mapped through `ph1_fuse.py`'s
own `LAT_RULES`/`LON_RULES` (`:60-69`), i.e. the **shipped** derivation, not one I invented:

| VLM emission | n | → LAT token | → LON token |
|---|---|---|---|
| `hold_corridor_none` | 136 | LANE_KEEP | ⚠️ **HOLD** |
| `reduce_to_none` | 31 | ⛔ **none** | ⛔ **none** |
| `prepare_lane_change_left` | 28 | LANE_CHANGE_L | none |
| `prepare_lane_change_right` | 26 | LANE_CHANGE_R | none |
| `hold_corridor_right` | 17 | LANE_KEEP | ⚠️ **HOLD** |
| `reduce_to_left` | 10 | ⛔ **none** | ⛔ **none** |
| `reduce_to_right` | 8 | ⛔ **none** | ⛔ **none** |
| `prepare_stop_none` | 6 | none | BRAKE_TO |
| `hold_corridor_left` | 6 | LANE_KEEP | ⚠️ **HOLD** |
| `prepare_exit_left` | 1 | none | none |
| `resume_cruise_none` | 1 | none | CRUISE |

**Two defects, both in the mapping (code), not in the VLM (data):**

1. ⛔ **`reduce_to` — the VLM's ONLY deceleration verb — maps to NOTHING**, on either axis.
   **49/270 = 18.1 % of all emissions are silently dropped.** The leg looks *silent* on those
   clips when it in fact spoke.
2. ⚠️ **`hold_corridor` is a LATERAL verb producing a LONGITUDINAL token.** It matches the
   `LON_RULES` substring `"hold"` → `HOLD`. That is 159/270 = 58.9 % of emissions.

**The consequence, MEASURED:** the resulting longitudinal leg is
`vlm_lon_v6 = {HOLD: 156, BRAKE_TO: 6, None: 39}` → projected to 3 bands,
**`vlm_lon3 = {decelerate: 162, None: 39}`. It emits exactly ONE value on every clip where it
speaks.** Its Cohen's κ against both other legs is **exactly 0.0000** — not "no skill", but *a
constant*. **In total 104/270 = 38.5 % of emissions produce no longitudinal token and
57/270 = 21.1 % produce no lateral token.**

⇒ **The VLM's tactical longitudinal contribution to every fused record in the corpus is a mapping
artifact.** This is a code fix, not a re-labelling job.

### 1.4 The ego leg — and ⛔ **it is NOT independent of the VLM**

`ph1_fuse.emit_vocab` counts `ego` and `vlm` as two of three votes (`:319-334`). **They share their
input.**

**MEASURED:** `_ego_prompt_mode == 'past'` on **201/201** aug120 v2 records. The block shown to the
VLM contains 13 fields including **`motion`, `turning`, `net_dyaw_rad`, `yaw_rate_rad_s`**. The ph1
ego voter reads **exactly `turning` and `motion`** (`:318-325`) — **both are in the VLM's prompt.**

**The signature this leaves is unmistakable:**

| contrast | Cohen's κ | reading |
|---|---|---|
| VLM ↔ ego-geometry (LAT) | **0.7608** | substantial |
| Alpamayo ↔ VLM (LAT) | 0.1717 | slight |
| Alpamayo ↔ ego-geometry (LAT) | 0.2089 | slight |

If the VLM were doing independent vision, its agreement with **Alpamayo** — which consumed the
**full camera rig** — should be comparable to its agreement with ego. Instead it agrees **≈4.4×
better (in κ)** with the leg whose numbers were **printed in its prompt**. ⇒ **A 2-of-3 majority
satisfied by {ego, vlm} is ONE source counted twice.** This is the action-echo defect
(`EVAL_DOCTRINE` §1.12) and the nav-echo defect, in a labelling costume.

#### ⛔ ESCALATION — the banked corpus carries a FALSE provenance stamp, on 201/201

Every fused aug120 record stamps `_provenance.vlm = "vision"` and lists `semantics` in
`inference_admissible`, while its own v2 source says `_ego_prompt_mode = 'past'`. **MEASURED:
201/201 contradicted.** `ph1_fuse.py:556-561` computes this **correctly at HEAD**
(`"vision+ego-past-prompt+engineA-prompt"`, and drops `semantics` from the whitelist) — **the
banked corpus predates the fix and has not been re-fused.** Until it is, no downstream consumer may
read `semantics` from these records as a vision-only signal.

## 2. THE AGREEMENT MEASUREMENT — the headline is the disagreement rate

⚠️ **THE TWO n's, stated separately as the PI required:**

| | n | bound |
|---|---|---|
| **LABEL-SIDE** (Alpamayo alone) | **4,729 clips** | complete; full camera rig; **nothing to regenerate** |
| **AGREEMENT-SIDE** (≥2 legs speak) | **201 clips** | bounded by **OUR w120 video cache**, not by label availability |

All three legs speak on all **201**. Artifact: `raw/a3_three_leg_agreement.json`.
⚠️ The 3-way projection (`left/straight/right`, `decelerate/maintain/accelerate`) discards
Alpamayo's severity, so **every agreement figure below is an UPPER BOUND** on agreement at full
resolution.

### 2.1 Pairwise — MEASURED, n as marked

| contrast | n | agree | **disagree** | κ | chance |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| LAT · Alpamayo ↔ ego-geom | 193 | 0.6166 | **0.3834** | 0.2089 | 0.5153 |
| LAT · Alpamayo ↔ VLM | 185 | 0.5946 | **0.4054** | 0.1717 | 0.5106 |
| LAT · VLM ↔ ego-geom ⚠️ *not independent* | 193 | 0.8964 | 0.1036 | **0.7608** | 0.5668 |
| LON · Alpamayo ↔ ego-geom | 201 | 0.4527 | **0.5473** | 0.1871 | 0.3268 |
| LON · Alpamayo ↔ VLM | 162 | 0.4321 | **0.5679** | **0.0000** | 0.4321 |
| LON · VLM ↔ ego-geom | 162 | 0.3272 | **0.6728** | **0.0000** | 0.3272 |
| `g_tac_lat`-level · Alpamayo lane ↔ VLM | 176 | 0.7045 | 0.2955 | **0.0139** | 0.7004 |
| `g_tac_lat`-level · Alpamayo lane ↔ ego lane-events | 153 | 0.4314 | 0.5686 | **−0.0240** | 0.4447 |

**Silence is counted separately and never folded in:** on LON the VLM is silent on **39** clips
(the `reduce_to` drop); on LAT Alpamayo is silent on 8 (the `Stop` rows) and the VLM on 8.

### 2.2 Three-way unanimity — ⛔ the longitudinal number is the alarming one

| axis | all 3 speak | **unanimous** | 2-of-3 | all 3 differ |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| LAT | 185 | 104 = **56.22 %** | 79 | 2 |
| LON | 162 | 31 = **19.14 %** | 109 | 22 |

**On four clips in five the three legs do not agree on what the vehicle is doing longitudinally.**

### 2.3 ⭐ INDEPENDENT CORROBORATION OF THE PI's ≈78 % LANE-CHANGE FINDING

On the 81 clips where engine-A's lane-change events fire **and** Alpamayo speaks, **Alpamayo
corroborates 2 — 2.47 %.** On **77** of the remaining 79 it says **Lane Keep**. Reciprocally, of
the 12 clips where Alpamayo declares a lane change or shift, our events agree on 2.

The PI adjudicated 19 clips by eye and derived a true incidence of **≈2 %**. Alpamayo — a
completely different instrument, which saw the full camera rig — independently lands at **2.5 %**.
**Two independent methods, the same answer.** κ = **−0.0240**: the two are very slightly
*anti*-correlated.

⚠️ **Scope, stated honestly:** this uses engine-A's **raw `lane_change_events`**, which sit
**upstream** of `_gated_lc_event()` — the gate the PI reviewed (9.5 % fire rate) applies further
conditions. My cohort therefore fires far more often (81/153). The two measurements agree in
*direction and magnitude of the error*, not in base rate, and I do not claim otherwise.

## 3. ⭐ THE DISCRIMINATING EXPERIMENT — the longitudinal disagreement is HALF a horizon artifact

The `alp=decelerate / ego=accelerate` cell alone is **43/201 = 21.4 %** — far too big for noise.
Two hypotheses, **both written down before the run** (`code/tac_a4_horizon_sweep.py:20-38`):

- **H-HORIZON** — the legs answer different questions (Alpamayo = the decision *at t0*; engine-A's
  `net_dv_ms` = net change over the whole **11.9 s** future). *Predicts agreement rises sharply as
  the horizon shortens.*
- **H-CONFLICT** — they disagree about the same question. *Predicts near-chance at every horizon.*

**MEASURED** on all 201 local ego pose tracks (10 Hz, t0 = index 80), 0 dropped. κ vs Alpamayo,
each cell the **best threshold at that horizon** (full 72-cell grids in `raw/a4_horizon_sweep.json`):

| horizon → | 0.5 s | 1.0 s | 2.0 s | 3.0 s | 5.0 s | 8.0 s | **11.8 s** |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| **LON** | 0.331 | 0.355 | **0.365** | 0.344 | 0.253 | 0.187 | **0.188** |
| **LAT** | 0.337 | 0.460 | **0.469** | 0.462 | 0.444 | 0.396 | **0.290** |

**Verdict: H-HORIZON SUPPORTED, and it is a RIDGE not a spike** — 16 of 72 swept cells lie within
0.05 κ of the peak, and they occupy **horizons 0.5–3.0 s and nothing longer**. The current
production reading (full window) sits in the **worst** region of the surface.

- **Longitudinal:** κ **→ 0.3655** at **H = 2.0 s, |Δv| ≥ 0.75 m/s**. Against the pre-registered
  full-window baseline (11.8 s, 1.0 m/s) κ = 0.1727 the lift is **+0.1928**; against the
  *strictest* comparison — the best cell anywhere in the full-window column, κ = 0.188 — it is
  **+0.177**. **It roughly doubles either way**, and the conclusion does not depend on which
  baseline is chosen.
- **Lateral:** κ **0.290 → 0.4694** at **H = 2.0 s, |Δyaw| ≥ 0.05 rad** (agreement 0.7202, n=193).
- ~~**Both axes peak at 2.0 s** — which is exactly the v6 tactical band (`g_tac` is the 2–6 s layer,
  `v6.py:161`). The label horizon and the architecture agree.~~
  ⛔ **RETRACTED — this sentence is the C89 defect.** See §3.1.
- **Abstaining on the ambiguous middle helps:** dropping Alpamayo's two *"Gentle"* classes lifts
  κ **0.3655 → 0.4311** (n falls 201 → 85). ⚠️ Both figures are **SEAM** values.

⚠️ Caveats I will not bury: the lateral optimum sits at the **smallest threshold swept** (0.05 rad)
— a finer grid could move it, though the ridge extends to 0.10 rad at κ 0.40–0.44, so it is not a
knife-edge. And κ ≈ 0.37–0.47 is *"fair to moderate"* — **improved, but NOT good enough to ship
without abstention.**

## 3.1 ⛔ CORRECTION (2026-08-17) — EVERY κ IN §3 IS A **SEAM** VALUE, NOT A BAND VALUE

⚠️ **The numbers above are not deleted, and must not be.** They are correct measurements of the
quantity they actually computed. What was wrong is the *name* attached to them, and the sentence
that let the name pass — so they are kept, relabelled, and the true band values are given beside
them. **Old numbers stay so the shape of the error stays legible.**

**Defect 1 — the horizon was an argmax, not a spec lookup (C89).** 2.0 s is the **SEAM** at which
operative authority ends and tactical begins. The binding spec is one grep:

```
stack/tanitad/models/v6.py:136-140
PLAN_STEPS = 60 · DT = 0.1 · HORIZON_S = 6.0
OP_BAND_S  = (0.0, 2.0)   # operative
TAC_BAND_S = (2.0, 6.0)   # TACTICAL
```

⛔ **Defect 2 — and the obvious correction was ALSO wrong.** C89 proposed restating at the sweep's
**6.0 s** row (LON 0.2331 / LAT 0.4040). **Those are not band values either.**
`code/tac_a4_horizon_sweep.py:140-148` anchors **every** horizon at `t0`:

```python
k  = min(int(round(t0 + H * POSE_HZ)), poses.shape[0] - 1)
dv = float(v[k] - v[t0])          # <-- anchored at t0, at EVERY horizon
```

⇒ the row labelled `2.0` is the net change over **(0.0, 2.0]** — i.e. exactly `OP_BAND_S`, the
**operative** band — and the row labelled `6.0` is **(0.0, 6.0]**, the **full horizon with the
operative band inside it**. **No row in the banked sweep is the tactical band.** The band quantity
had to be computed fresh: anchored at **t0+20** and read across **t0+21 … t0+60**.

**The interval-vs-endpoint choice, stated before any κ was computed.** "At 6.0 s" (one sample) and
"over (2.0, 6.0]" (the interval the tactical layer owns) are different quantities. The PI:
*"tactical behavior is evolving until 6s horizon (this is the whole resulting trajectory)"*;
`v6.py` §4b: *"bands are SLICES of one rollout"*. ⇒ **PRIMARY = `mean_band`**, the mean over the 40
in-band samples of the deviation from the band start — both ends inside the band (P1), reads the
whole slice rather than two samples (P2), robust to one bad pose sample (P3).

**⭐ THE RESTATED NUMBERS.** Estimator: **episode-cluster bootstrap** over clips, 2000 draws
(`taniteval/ci.py`); ⛔ never `overlapping_holdout_se`. Thresholds are the **PRODUCTION** values
(`code/tac_a3_three_leg_agreement.py:120-121`, Δv 1.0 m/s / Δyaw 0.15 rad) — a spec lookup.

| quantity | window | LON κ [95 % CI] | LAT κ [95 % CI] | n (LON/LAT) |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| ⭐ **TACTICAL BAND** `mean_band` | **(2.0, 6.0]** | **0.1428** [0.0540, 0.2250] | **0.1777** [0.0658, 0.2953] | 201 / 193 |
| band, `net_band` *(sensitivity)* | (2.0, 6.0] | 0.1526 [0.0527, 0.2411] | 0.2196 [0.1043, 0.3422] | 201 / 193 |
| band, `ext_band` *(sensitivity)* | (2.0, 6.0] | 0.1788 [0.0751, 0.2751] | 0.2301 [0.1145, 0.3477] | 201 / 193 |
| ⚠️ *seam* — what §3 reports | (0.0, 2.0] = `OP_BAND_S` | 0.3270 [0.2289, 0.4192] | 0.3132 [0.1973, 0.4323] | 201 / 193 |
| ⚠️ *full horizon* — the sweep's "6.0 s" | (0.0, 6.0] | 0.2210 [0.1165, 0.3167] | 0.3806 [0.2587, 0.4911] | 201 / 193 |

**Paired band − seam** (same clips, same resampled draw, `paired_episode_cluster_bootstrap`):
**LON Δκ = −0.1843** [−0.2746, −0.0961], **CI-separated**; **LAT Δκ = −0.1354** [−0.2707, −0.0162],
**CI-separated**. ⇒ **The drop is real, not sampling noise, on both axes.**

⚠️ **It is not a threshold artefact either.** Across the whole swept surface the band's best cell
is **LON 0.1862** (Δv 0.25) and **LAT 0.3125** (Δyaw 0.05) — *still below* the seam values at every
comparable threshold. The band is worse under every definition and every threshold tried.

⚠️ **Defect 3, found in passing — §3 also argmax-selected its THRESHOLD.** The headline cells
(Δv 0.75 / Δyaw 0.05) are the sweep's best-scoring thresholds, not production values. C89 caught
only the horizon. Both are the same root-cause class: *a measurement window chosen by its result.*

⇒ **WHAT THIS CHANGES.** The §3 verdict *"H-HORIZON SUPPORTED"* stands as a statement about
**agreement vs horizon** — agreement really does rise as the horizon shortens. What does **not**
follow, and what §3 wrongly asserted, is that this licenses reading a **tactical** label short.
**At the architecture's own band the Alpamayo↔ego agreement is κ ≈ 0.14–0.18 — "slight", below the
0.40 fair-to-moderate line, and not shippable as a label source.**

⭐ **The most probable substantive reading, and it is a work item, not a conclusion:** Alpamayo's
meta-action is *the decision at t0*, while `TAC_BAND_S` covers **2–6 s**.

> ⛔ **SELF-CORRECTION, same day, before the PI reviewed anything.** I first wrote here that *"by
> 2–6 s the ordinary turns are already resolved, so the band contains the **aftermath** of the
> manoeuvre"*, generalising from the two RIGHT-turn classes I happened to inspect. ⛔ **That is
> false as a general statement, and the per-class table below refutes it.** The seam→band relation
> is **ASYMMETRIC BY TURN DIRECTION**: right-hand classes shrink toward zero across the band, but
> **left-hand classes GROW** — the opposite of "aftermath". *Root-cause class: a mechanism inferred
> from a subset of the classes and stated over all of them — the same shape as the C89 family
> (a quantity named from what was convenient rather than from what was computed).*

**MEASURED** (ours; 201 clips, artifact
`…/2026-08-16-tactical-review/raw/b1_band_agreement_per_clip.jsonl`). Mean Δyaw per Alpamayo
lateral class, seam vs band, positive = LEFT:

| Alpamayo LAT | n | seam Δyaw **(0.0, 2.0]** | band net **(2.0, 6.0]** | band `mean_band` | ratio \|band net\|/\|seam\| | direction |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| `Steer Left` | 24 | +0.0161 | **+0.1082** | +0.0359 | **6.72×** | ⬆ **GROWS** |
| `Sharp Steer Left` | 4 | +0.1963 | **+0.3844** | +0.1660 | **1.96×** | ⬆ **GROWS** |
| `Steer Right` | 37 | −0.0569 | −0.0125 | −0.0004 | **0.22×** | ⬇ shrinks |
| `Sharp Steer Right` | 7 | −0.5371 | −0.2403 | −0.1565 | **0.45×** | ⬇ shrinks |
| `Go Straight` | 121 | −0.0006 | +0.0085 | +0.0065 | — | ≈0 in both |

⇒ **LEFT classes (n=28) grow into the band; RIGHT classes (n=44) decay toward zero.** ⚠️ The two
`Sharp` rows rest on **n=4** and **n=7** and are weakly determined — the robust contrast is
`Steer Left` (n=24, grows 6.72×) against `Steer Right` (n=37, shrinks to 0.22×).

⭐ **AND THIS — not "aftermath" — IS THE LAT κ MECHANISM.** Against the production threshold
(0.15 rad), the **class means** of `Steer Left` (+0.1082) and `Steer Right` (−0.0125) both fall
below it, while the two `Sharp` class means still clear it (+0.3844 → `left`, −0.2403 → `right`).

⚠️ **Stated per clip, because a class mean is not a per-clip fact** *(and I first wrote this as
"all 61 ordinary `Steer *` clips collapse to `straight`", which is a mean-to-member overreach of
exactly the kind this section is correcting)*:

| at 0.15 rad | n | read `straight` by `mean_band` **(primary)** | by `net_band` |
|---|---|---|---|
| `Steer Left` | 24 | **19 (79 %)** | 13 (54 %) |
| `Steer Right` | 37 | **28 (76 %)** | 23 (62 %) |
| **ordinary `Steer *` combined** | **61** | **47 (77 %)** | 36 (59 %) |
| `Sharp Steer Left` | 4 | 2 (50 %) | 2 (50 %) |
| `Sharp Steer Right` | 7 | 4 (57 %) | 4 (57 %) |
| `Go Straight` *(reference)* | 121 | 110 (91 %) | 102 (84 %) |

⇒ **47 of the 61 ordinary-turn clips (77 %) read `straight` at the band** under the primary
statistic — and even the `Sharp` classes lose **half** their clips individually despite their means
clearing the threshold. The lateral signal does not merely get noisier; for most turning clips it
drops **under the decision threshold**, in one direction by decaying and in the other by not yet
having arrived.

⚠️ **HYPOTHESIS (not measured, do not quote as a finding):** left turns are executed *later* than
right turns — a left turn typically waits for a gap in oncoming traffic while a right turn goes
promptly — so a t0 label lands *mid-manoeuvre* for right turns and *pre-manoeuvre* for left turns.
That would predict the exact sign pattern above. It is testable on the same poses and has **not**
been tested.

⇒ **The falling κ may be telling us the LABEL SOURCE is mismatched to the band, not that the band
is unlabelable.** Discriminating that is the next experiment; it must not be assumed either way.
⚠️ **And the asymmetry means the mismatch is not a single fixable offset** — no one shift of the
read window can serve both directions at once, because the two move opposite ways across it.

**Artifacts:** `…/2026-08-16-tactical-review/code/tacrev_band_agreement.py` ·
`…/2026-08-16-tactical-review/raw/b1_band_agreement.json` (+ `_per_clip.jsonl`).
**Evidence class: MEASURED (ours), 201 local ego pose tracks, 10 Hz, 0 dropped.**

## 4. ⭐ MAPPING TO THE v6 VOCABULARY — and why "meta actions AND reasoning" is the right question

⛔ **I changed NO vocabulary tuple.** They size `GoalVocabulary(...)` (`v6.py:3281-3397`) and a
shape change breaks strict resume on the live 30k Thor run. Everything below is a **report**.

### 4.1 Alpamayo LANE axis → `TACTICAL_LAT_ACTIONS` — maps cleanly, with **one real gap**

| Alpamayo Lane | → v6 | % of corpus |
|---|---|---|
| Lane Keep | `LANE_KEEP` | 85.33 |
| Left / Right Lane Change | `LANE_CHANGE_L` / `_R` | 0.47 / 1.73 |
| Slightly Shift Left / Right | `NUDGE_L` / `NUDGE_R` | 1.46 / 0.66 |
| **Turn Left / Turn Right** | ⛔ **NO TOKEN EXISTS** | **1.80 / 2.14 (n = 186)** |
| — | `ABORT_LC` — **no Alpamayo source; would receive 0 labels** | 0 |

### 4.2 Alpamayo LONGITUDINAL axis → `TACTICAL_LON_ACTIONS` — ⛔ **DOES NOT MAP**

This is the crux. **v6's longitudinal vocabulary is REASON-typed** (`FOLLOW`, `YIELD_MERGE`,
`CREEP`, `HOLD`, `BRAKE_TO`, `CRUISE`); **Alpamayo's axis is MAGNITUDE-typed** (`Gentle
Deceleration`, `Strong Acceleration`, …). *"Gentle Deceleration"* cannot say whether the vehicle is
`FOLLOW` (closing on a lead) or `BRAKE_TO` (a stop line) — **the reason decides, and the reason is
in `cot`.** Likewise `TACTICAL_GOAL_TOKENS_LON` (`GAP_TARGET`, `YIELD_AT`, `STOP_POINT`,
`TRAFFIC_LIGHT_REACT`, `WAIT_FOR_ONCOMING`, `SPEED_BAND`) is **purely** reason-typed and can come
from **nothing but** the reason field.

⇒ **The meta-action gives the axis and magnitude; the reason gives the token. Neither half is
sufficient. That is exactly why the PI asked about both together.**

### 4.3 Can the reason field actually reach those tokens? — MEASURED, n = 4,729

A **reachability** probe (`code/tac_a5_gtac_reason_coverage.py`) — it measures whether the text
mentions what a token needs. ⛔ **It measures reachability, NOT correctness.** Confusing the two
would be the S2 failure.

| | single leg (`meta_action.cot`) | union of both legs |
|---|---|---|
| reaches ≥1 `g_tac` token | **93.80 %** | **97.02 %** |
| reaches a **LON** token | **77.31 %** | **82.77 %** |
| reaches a **LAT** token | 20.00 % | 27.13 % |
| ambiguous (>1 LON token) | 8.94 % | 20.03 % |

Per-token mass (union): `SPEED_BAND` 30.03 % · `GAP_TARGET` 26.96 % · `EVADE_IN_CORRIDOR` 23.26 % ·
`STOP_POINT` 15.48 % · `TRAFFIC_LIGHT_REACT` 14.97 % · `YIELD_AT` 11.33 % · `WAIT_FOR_ONCOMING`
5.77 % · `ANCHOR_GOAL` 4.55 % · ⚠️ `CORRIDOR_OFFSET` **0.80 %** (effectively unlabellable from
reasons).

⭐ **The reliability estimate, from Alpamayo's own two semi-independent reason draws:** when both
legs reach a LON token, they reach the **same** one on **2,473/3,168 = 78.06 %**. Top confusions:
`STOP_POINT`↔`YIELD_AT` (211), `GAP_TARGET`↔`TRAFFIC_LIGHT_REACT` (108).

## 5. VERDICT AND SPECIFICATION

### 5.1 Can a trustworthy tactical label set be built today?

> ## ~~⚠️ **QUALIFIED YES — but only from Alpamayo, only at a 2 s horizon, only with abstention, and NOT by the current 2-of-3 vote.**~~
>
> ## ⛔ **DOWNGRADED 2026-08-17 (§3.1): NOT DEMONSTRATED AT THE ARCHITECTURE'S BAND.**
> The "qualified yes" rested on κ 0.4694 / 0.3655 **at the 2.0 s SEAM**. Over `TAC_BAND_S`
> **(2.0, 6.0]** the same construction gives **LAT κ 0.1777 / LON κ 0.1428** — *slight* agreement,
> paired-separated from the seam on both axes. ⇒ The qualified yes holds **only for a ~2 s
> operative-horizon label**, which is not the label `g_tac` needs. **What is still open — and is
> the next experiment, not a conclusion — is whether the band is unlabelable or whether Alpamayo's
> t0 meta-action is simply the wrong SOURCE for a 2–6 s window.**

| | |
|---|---|
| ✅ **Buildable now** | `a_tac_lat` (Alpamayo LANE axis) and `g_tac_lon` (Alpamayo reason). |
| ⚠️ **Buildable with abstention** | `a_tac_lon` — needs meta-action **×** reason jointly; expect κ ≈ 0.37–0.43. |
| ⛔ **NOT buildable** | `ABORT_LC` (no source, 0 labels) · `CORRIDOR_OFFSET` (0.80 % reach) · a `TURN_*` lateral action (**no token exists**; 186 clips have nowhere to go). |
| ⛔ **Must NOT be used as a leg** | the VLM tactical output (longitudinal is a constant; lateral is an ego echo) — **until the two mapping bugs in §1.3 are fixed and the corpus re-fused**. |

**n and expected error, stated plainly:**

| | n | expected error |
|---|---|---|
| label-side (Alpamayo, needs no video) | **4,729** | reason-token self-consistency **78.06 %** ⇒ **≈22 % expected label error** |
| validated against our geometry ⚠️ **SEAM (0.0, 2.0]** | **201** | LAT κ 0.4694 / LON κ 0.3655 at H=2 s; **≈30–45 % disagreement** without abstention |
| ⭐ validated against our geometry **at `TAC_BAND_S` (2.0, 6.0]** | **201 / 193** | **LAT κ 0.1777 / LON κ 0.1428** (§3.1); **≈36 % / ≈59 % disagreement** |
| after abstaining on Alpamayo's *"Gentle"* classes ⚠️ SEAM | **85** of 201 (42 %) | κ 0.4311 |

⇒ **This is materially better than the S2 case** (which was ≈78 % *wrong*, from inputs that
*could not carry the distinction*). Here the inputs **do** carry the distinction — Alpamayo saw
the full camera rig and declares on the right axes — and the residual error is measured,
bounded, and concentrated in a nameable ambiguous middle we can abstain on.

⛔ **But it is NOT good enough to ship unreviewed.** κ 0.37–0.47 with a ≈22 % expected label error
demands a **PI review of a sample before any training use** — the same gate the S2 labels got, and
which caught the failure there.

### 5.2 What is missing (the honest gap list)

1. ⛔ **A human-adjudicated sample.** Every number here is machine-vs-machine agreement. **No human
   has looked at a single tactical label.** This is the single largest gap.
2. ⛔ **Contamination is UNRESOLVED.** PhysicalAI-AV is listed as Alpamayo **training** data.
   ⇒ Alpamayo is a **teacher**, never ground truth, and this must be stamped on every derived label.
3. ⚠️ **One draw is not the mode.** Generation was `temperature 0.6`, seed 42, one draw per clip.
   Cross-draw stability is **UNMEASURED**. (The 78.06 % cross-leg figure is the nearest proxy.)
4. ⛔ **Re-fuse required** before the VLM leg is usable at all — the mapping bugs (§1.3) *and* the
   false provenance stamp (§1.4).
5. ⚠️ **`TURN_LEFT`/`TURN_RIGHT` have no lateral action token.** Reported, not changed.

### 5.3 The proposed derivation — SPECIFICATION ONLY, not implemented

**Source of truth: Alpamayo. Ego = corroboration. VLM = excluded until fixed.** ⛔ The 2-of-3
majority is **retired** — it cannot count ego and VLM as independent.

| label | computed from | inference-admissibility |
|---|---|---|
| `a_tac_lat` | Alpamayo LANE axis (§4.1), `NONE_ABSTAIN` for `Turn *` | ✅ label-time only; **inference stays vision-only** |
| `a_tac_lon` | Alpamayo LONGITUDINAL **×** reason, abstain on `Gentle *` unless the reason disambiguates | ✅ same |
| `g_tac_lon` | Alpamayo reason → token (§4.3); abstain on multi-hit (**20.03 %**) | ✅ same |
| `corroboration.ego` | ⛔ **CORRECTED (§3.1):** ego pose **over `TAC_BAND_S` (2.0, 6.0]**, statistic `mean_band`, PRODUCTION thresholds (`|Δv| ≥ 1.0 m/s`, `|Δyaw| ≥ 0.15 rad`) — **recorded, never the source**. ~~ego pose at H = 2.0 s (`|Δv| ≥ 0.75 m/s`, `|Δyaw| ≥ 0.05 rad`)~~ — that was the **seam** at **argmax-selected** thresholds. | privileged-labels-only |

**Binding-constraint compliance, checked explicitly:**

- ⛔ **Labels may use ego; inference is vision-only.** Every label above is derived **offline**
  from Alpamayo text + ego poses. **Nothing enters the model at inference.** ✅
- ⛔ **Goal/situation information-disjointness.** *"Could this have been computed from the
  situation classifier's output?"* — **No.** Alpamayo's meta-action and reason are produced by an
  **external model from camera data**, with no access to `situations.py` or any TanitAD classifier
  output. The ego corroboration reads raw poses, not situation labels. ✅
  ⚠️ **One live hazard to guard at implementation:** `ph1_fuse.py:355` asserts the string
  `"situation"` is absent from the vocab block. That assert must be **kept** on any new emission.

### 5.4 The loss term — SPECIFICATION ONLY (⛔ do not wire; separate reviewed step)

Following the `w_s2_goal` template exactly (`train_v6_staged.py:206-217`):

```
w_tac_goal: float = 0.0      # DEFAULT 0.0 = OFF EVERYWHERE
```

| property | value | why |
|---|---|---|
| default | **0.0**, off everywhere | the incumbent loss stays **bit-identical**; the live v6F S-W resume on Thor (step ~8,900) is untouched |
| gradient reach | **goal heads only — NEVER a trunk loss** | the binding diagram rule; mirror `test_v6_s2_loss.py`'s exact-reach assertion for `goal_head_tac.*` / `act_head_tac.*` |
| stages | **in force only in the stage that trains `layer_tac`**; zeroed elsewhere | `w_s2_goal` is S-S/S-J only, for the same reason |
| objective | CE on `g_tac_lat`/`g_tac_lon` + `a_tac_lat`/`a_tac_lon` logits, **masked to a `tac_valid` band** | abstains and `Stop`-rows' absent axes must be **masked, not labelled** |
| ⛔ precondition | **a PI-reviewed label sample must exist first** | this is the S2 gate that worked |

**Evaluation — the four families are not optional.** TACTICAL is one of them: report
**manoeuvre-decision quality** (selected vs executed, confusion over the classes) **and tactical
goal-setting**, per family, never pooled, with **paired episode-cluster bootstrap** intervals
(`taniteval/ci.py`) — ⛔ never `overlapping_holdout_se` — and every number stamped with its **eval
tier** (T1 for any capability claim).

### 5.5 Scaling — ⛔ NOT blocked on Alpamayo coverage

Per the PI's correction, and confirmed by a read-only trace of the pipeline:

- **The labels are done.** 4,729 clips, full camera rig, nothing to regenerate.
- **The missing artifact is OUR video** — `<clip_id>.v2ep.pt`, 256×640 cylindrical
  `camera_front_wide_120fov`.
- **The builder is a solved, repeatable, idempotent, CPU-only job:**
  `stack/scripts/v2_compressed.py build` — **MEASURED 19.4 s/clip single-shard, 660 clips/h at 8
  shards, ~40 MB/clip** (`…/2026-07-28-wide-fov-build/WIDE_FOV_BUILD.md:377-386`). It is
  **download-bound, not compute-bound**, and it **refuses re-selection by construction**
  (`v2_compressed.py:388-393`).
- **The existing 257 were never built for Alpamayo** — they are the intersection of the 4,729 with
  the pre-existing canonical 3,000-clip w120 parity corpus (**201 train + 56 val**).
- **ESTIMATED** for the remaining 4,472: **≈6.8 h at 8 shards** (24.1 h single-shard), **≈179 GB**.
- ⚠️ **Parity, precisely:** the 257 **are canonical parity members** — w120 is a *re-cache, not a
  re-selection* (`parity_manifest.json:2514-2525`, `derived_from: physicalai-train-e438721ae894`).
  The **4,472 are a genuinely new selection** and are admissible **as a separate labelled corpus,
  not as an extension of the parity set** (`NEXT_4472_BUILD_INPUTS.md:22`). Say so explicitly or
  the first trainer that eats it breaks comparability.

⇒ **The path to scale is extracting more video — schedulable CPU compute — not re-labelling.**
